description: Autonomously syndicate a published Lokha article or broadcast standalone custom copy across connected Buffer channels and Zernio multi-network accounts.

content.description: Direct standalone copy to broadcast (use if not syndicating a specific Lokha post)

customText.description: Optional custom viral text/hook when syndicating an article

providers.description: Optional list of specific providers to broadcast to (defaults to all connected)

scheduledFor.description: Optional ISO 8601 date string for scheduled release

slugOrId.description: The slug or numerical ID of a published Lokha post to syndicate (optional if content is provided)

name: lokha_broadcast_to_socials
